rules.title: Truth in Renting Act Security Deposit Requirements
rules.requirement: Landlords must comply with New Jersey statutes regarding security deposits, including disclosure and handling requirements.
rules.summary_plain: Your landlord must follow state laws about security deposits, including how they handle and disclose them.
rules.summary_plain_es: Su arrendador debe cumplir con las leyes estatales sobre depósitos de seguridad, incluyendo cómo manejarlos y divulgarlos.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Applies to residential rental dwelling units in New Jersey.
rules.exemptions_text: Does not apply to hotels, motels, or other guest houses serving transient or seasonal tenants.
rules.quoted_span: Every landlord subject to the Truth in Renting Act, (N.J.S.A. 46:8-43 to 51), hereinafter the Act, is required to distribute one copy of the Truth in Renting Statement to each of their tenants within 30 days after it has been posted by the Department on its website and shall thereafter provide a copy of the most current statement to each new tenant at or prior to the time the tenant executes a lease for the rental unit.

rules.title: Anti-Eviction Protections for Mobile Home Tenants
rules.requirement: Mobile home park landlords must comply with the Anti-Eviction Act and other landlord-tenant laws including protections against self-help evictions and reprisal.
rules.summary_plain: If you rent a mobile home space, your landlord must follow special eviction protections under state law.
rules.summary_plain_es: Si alquila un espacio para casa móvil, su arrendador debe seguir protecciones especiales contra desalojos según la ley estatal.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Applies to tenants renting space in mobile home parks or private residential leasehold communities in New Jersey.
rules.quoted_span: Mobile homeowners or residents of private residential leasehold communities are also tenants if they rent space in either of these types of communities. Therefore, they are afforded certain protections under New Jersey statutes and regulations, i.e, the Anti-Eviction Act, Homestead Property, Tax Credit Act and special protections under the Mobile Home Act.
